usedFor: Userflow holds your onboarding users, and Gtwy runs your AI when “User Created” runs “Call AI Agent Instantly”.

bestTemplate.name: “User Created” in Userflow, then “Call AI Agent Instantly” in Gtwy
bestTemplate.why: Each new user sends a chat request to your selected AI agent, with custom variables from the user.

watchOut: “Group Updated” fires on every change, so the same group can reach Gtwy repeatedly.
